title: Network-Wide Freeway Speed Nowcasting and Forecasting from Sparse Fixed Sensors with a Probe-Supervised Graph Convolutional Recurrent Network
abstract: arXiv:2610.22630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traffic agencies need current and near-future speeds on every link of their network, but their fixed sensors cover only part of it. We study joint nowcasting and next-hour forecasting of hourly speeds on all 4{,}127 directional freeway links of the Dallas--Fort Worth region from sensors on 643 links (15.6%). Historical probe-vehicle data supervise every link in training; only sensor readings are used at inference. We call this setting probe-supervised sparse sensing. We propose GCRN+, a graph convolutional recurrent network that predicts deviations from a historical speed profile. It combines a parameter-free, direction-aware kernel interpolation of sensor anomalies, used as input features and as an output baseline, with a diffusion-convolutional GRU on the directed road graph, a low-rank adaptive graph and learnable link embeddings. It scales linearly with network size and trains on a CPU. Sensor readings are emulated from probe speed

translated_title: 基于探针监督图卷积循环网络利用稀疏固定传感器实现全网高速公路速度的即时估计与预测
translated_abstract: 交通管理部门需要其路网上每条路段的当前及近期未来速度，但固定传感器仅覆盖了部分路网。我们研究了仅利用643条路段（15.6%）上的传感器，对达拉斯—沃斯堡地区全部4,127条有向高速公路路段的逐小时速度进行联合即时估计（nowcasting）与下一小时预测的问题。在训练阶段，历史探针车辆数据对所有路段进行监督；而在推理阶段仅使用传感器读数。我们将这一设置称为“探针监督稀疏感知”。我们提出了GCRN+，一种预测速度相对历史速度曲线偏差的图卷积循环网络。该方法将无参数、方向感知的传感器异常核插值（同时用作输入特征和输出基线），与有向路网图上的扩散卷积GRU、低秩自适应图以及可学习的路段嵌入相结合。该模型随网络规模线性扩展，并可在CPU上完成训练。传感器读数由探针速度模拟生成
tldr: 该论文提出GCRN+模型，一种探针监督的图卷积循环网络，仅利用15.6%路段的固定传感器数据即可对达拉斯—沃斯堡地区全部4,127条有向高速公路路段实现速度的即时估计与未来一小时预测，且随网络规模线性扩展并可在CPU上训练。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GCRN+, a probe-supervised graph convolutional recurrent network that performs network-wide freeway speed nowcasting and next-hour forecasting using only sparse fixed sensors covering 15.6% of links, while scaling linearly with network size and training on a CPU.
